latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Argument Organization Reviser skill.
- Applies a four-level top-down procedure to revise the structural organization of research paper drafts: (1) Frame (intro/conclusion alignment), (2) Argument (section reasons & evidence ratios), (3) Paper Organization (key-term threading & section signals), (4) Paragraphs (topic sentence placement & length).
- Designed for users with a complete draft who need structural revision, not prose style or clarity.
- Clearly distinguishes triggers, use cases, and boundaries (redirects users needing argument-building or prose revision to other skills).
- Annotates diagnoses and specific repair recommendations at each structural level before moving to the next.
- Optimized for researchers, students, and professionals preparing drafts for submission.
